## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A Hoverfly two-page cursor walk ingests every bookmark from both pages...

The system SHALL ensure that a Hoverfly two-page cursor walk ingests every bookmark from both pages exactly once.

#### Scenario: A Hoverfly two-page cursor walk ingests every bookmark from both pages...

WHEN `ingest-x-bookmarks-incrementally-as-content-rows` is implemented
THEN A Hoverfly two-page cursor walk ingests every bookmark from both pages exactly once.

### Requirement: A second run against unchanged bookmarks fetches exactly one page and...

The system SHALL ensure that a second run against unchanged bookmarks fetches exactly one page and ingests zero rows, and --full walks every page.

#### Scenario: A second run against unchanged bookmarks fetches exactly one page and...

WHEN `ingest-x-bookmarks-incrementally-as-content-rows` is implemented
THEN A second run against unchanged bookmarks fetches exactly one page and ingests zero rows, and --full walks every page.

### Requirement: A bookmarked post that Grok search later surfaces is deduplicated by...

The system SHALL ensure that a bookmarked post that Grok search later surfaces is deduplicated by source_id and not inserted twice.

#### Scenario: A bookmarked post that Grok search later surfaces is deduplicated by...

WHEN `ingest-x-bookmarks-incrementally-as-content-rows` is implemented
THEN A bookmarked post that Grok search later surfaces is deduplicated by source_id and not inserted twice.

### Requirement: The ingestion filter hook and reference hook run on ingested bookmark rows...

The system SHALL ensure that the ingestion filter hook and reference hook run on ingested bookmark rows like any other adapter.

#### Scenario: The ingestion filter hook and reference hook run on ingested bookmark rows...

WHEN `ingest-x-bookmarks-incrementally-as-content-rows` is implemented
THEN The ingestion filter hook and reference hook run on ingested bookmark rows like any other adapter.
